 Manchester weather update: Expect heavy rain and cool temperatures on October 24, 2026 
 Manchester weather update: Expect heavy rain and cool temperatures on October 24, 2026 
 Oct 24, 2026, 10:48 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Latest weather update and forecast for Manchester. Manchester, October 24, 2026, is set to experience heavy rain throughout the day. With a high temperature reaching 14°C and a low of 9°C, residents can expect a damp and cool atmosphere. The chance of rainfall stands at a significant 70%, indicating that umbrellas and raincoats will be essential elements for those venturing outside. Wind speeds are expected to be brisk, further adding to the chilly feel on this rainy day. Manchester Weather Today
 Today's weather in Manchester will be dominated by heavy rain, presenting a wet start to the weekend. Expect temperatures to peak at 14°C in the afternoon, dipping to a cooler 9°C overnight. The humidity level will be quite high as well, reflecting the pervasive moisture in the air. Given the 70% chance of rain, residents should prepare for likely downpours during the day. Wind conditions are anticipated to be challenging, although specific gust speeds are currently unavailable. Indeed, it would be wise to plan indoor activities or ensure proper rain gear if you need to travel. Umbrellas and waterproof footwear advised
 Given the heavy rainfall expected today, it is advisable for residents to carry umbrellas and wear waterproof footwear when heading out. The rainy conditions not only increase the chances of getting wet but also could affect visibility and road conditions. As outdoor plans might be hampered by the elements, consider engaging in indoor activities or rescheduling any outdoor events. If you must travel, do so with caution, as wet roads could lead to slippery conditions. Manchester Weather for Upcoming 7 Days

 Following today's heavy rainfall, the upcoming days will show a mixture of weather patterns. Tomorrow, Manchester will experience light showers, with temperatures cooling down slightly to a high of 11°C and a low of 7°C. Monday is forecasted to bring heavier rain again, peaking at a comfortable 16°C, before the weather begins to clear towards the middle of the week, with sunny intervals returning for several days. Residents can expect the warmest day to be next Monday, while the coolest temperatures will occur as we approach the end of October with the highs gradually falling. The chance of rain appears to be more sporadic after today, with calmer conditions expected by mid-week. As the week progresses, Manchester will see fluctuating temperatures but a trend towards drier conditions might encourage residents to plan for more outdoor activities, particularly where sunny intervals are reported.
